name: Meitei/Manipuri (Meetei Mayek script)

ancestors.notes: Same language as `mni` (spelled there in Bengali/Latin); Meetei Mayek is Manipuri's own historical script, re-adopted as the sole official script of Manipur by state order in 2021. See `iu-Latn` for the script-suffixed sibling-spec precedent.

notes: Meetei Mayek (ꯃꯤꯇꯩ ꯃꯌꯦꯛ), the pre-19th-century native abugida of Meitei/Manipuri, banned under Vaishnavite Bengali-script pressure from the 1700s and formally reinstated as Manipur's sole official script by a 2021 state cabinet order (replacing Bengali script). Spelled here as a SEPARATE spec from `mni` (which encodes the still-current Bengali/Latin renderings) following the `iu-Latn` script-suffix precedent, because the letter-to-sound mapping is specific to this script, not to the language. GRAPHEME KEYS: the 18 traditional consonant letters (`kok` /k/ through `un` /u/, Chelliah 1997; Meetei script Wikipedia table) plus the seven post-base vowel-diacritic signs (matras) and the independent vowel-carrier letters ꯑ/ꯏ/ꯎ. `ꯪ` (`nung`) is polysemous: as a post-vowel FINAL sign it spells syllable-final /ŋ/ (the same phoneme as the base letter ꯉ), included here undifferentiated by position pending a `positional_graphemes` split. KNOWN GAP, documented rather than guessed (AGENTS.md rule 4): the traditional Mayek writes only 18 native consonants; NINE additional consonant letters were added in the 20th century to spell voiced/loan consonants absent from native Meitei (b, d, dʒ, g, r, z, and geminate-marking letters per Chelliah 1997 and the Meetei-script Wikipedia article) but this source material did not give exact glyph-to-codepoint correspondences precise enough to cite safely, so those nine letters are left UNMAPPED here rather than filled with an unsourced guess -- a spec gap, not a silent omission. Same phoneme set, aspiration and stress facts as `mni`: no lexical stress is described for Meitei in Chelliah (1997), so stress is left unencoded (a documented exemption, not an oversight). TIER: no WikiPron (or other registrable) gold exists for `mni`/Meetei Mayek (checked against CUNY-CL/wikipron's scrape summary, 2026-08-03: zero rows), so this stays `skeleton`, not `research`.
